info.title: Expat Living Italy — data API
info.description: Honest, sourced numbers for people relocating to or retiring in Italy. Per comune: population, foreign residents by citizenship, property purchase and rent price, verified tax-regime eligibility, and every Italy-map layer (climate, air quality, crime, healthcare quality, age, population change) plus the province's ISTAT BES well-being indicators — each labeled with the level it is measured at. Look a comune up by name with GET /comuni?q= to get its ISTAT code, then GET /comuni/{istatCode}. GET /datasets lists every dataset behind the site with its source, vintage, grain, license, page and a full JSON download; the Eurostat/OECD NUTS-region layers are available there but not per comune. Every value carries provenance (source, vintage, extraction date, coverage) and missing data returns null with a reason — never a zero, never an imputed average. Tax-eligibility results describe places, not people: they are not advice. Every response carries an `attribution` block. Free to use. Please credit "Expat Living Italy (expatliving.it)" and link the page the figures come from whenever you quote them.

get.summary: Find a comune by name, or find comuni by criteria
get.description: Two questions on one path. With only `q` (and `limit`), a case- and accent-insensitive name search across all ~7,900 Italian comuni returns identifiers (ISTAT code, province, region, page URL) — call getComune with the code for the numbers; several comuni share a name, so check the province. With any other parameter it finds comuni by criteria: region, province, population, purchase price, rent, population change 2019–2025 and the verified comuni of a tax regime, paged (max 100) and sorted. A comune with no price, rent or population-change figure is left out of the filter on it and counted in `missingData` — never treated as cheap, free or stable. `taxRegime` lists only comuni on the regime's verified routes: a comune missing from it is not a "no".

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A comune name or part of one, e.g. "Introdacqua". Alone: name search (2–80 characters, up to 25 results). With other filters: only comuni whose name contains it.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Name search: 1–25, default 10. Filters: 1–100, default 25.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: A region name or slug, e.g. "Abruzzo".

parameters.name: province
parameters.description: A province's two-letter code ("AQ") or slug.

parameters.name: minPopulation
parameters.description: Residents, inclusive.

parameters.name: maxPopulation
parameters.description: Residents, inclusive.

parameters.name: minPurchasePriceEurM2
parameters.description: Purchase price in EUR/m2, inclusive. A comune with no price is left out, never treated as cheap.

parameters.name: maxPurchasePriceEurM2
parameters.description: Purchase price in EUR/m2, inclusive. A comune with no price is left out, never treated as cheap.

parameters.name: minRentEurM2Month
parameters.description: Rent in EUR/m2 per month, inclusive. A comune with no rent figure is left out.

parameters.name: maxRentEurM2Month
parameters.description: Rent in EUR/m2 per month, inclusive. A comune with no rent figure is left out.

parameters.name: minPopulationChangePct
parameters.description: Population change 2019 to 2025, in percent, inclusive. Negative means decline.

parameters.name: maxPopulationChangePct
parameters.description: Population change 2019 to 2025, in percent, inclusive.

parameters.name: taxRegime
parameters.description: A verified geographic regime slug from /tax/regimes. Lists only comuni on its verified routes; one missing from the list is not a "no".

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key; a comune without a figure for it sorts last.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Default desc for population and populationChange, asc otherwise.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip, for the next page.

get.summary: Where one nationality concentrates in Italy
get.description: For one of the citizenships this site tracks: the comuni, provinces and regions where its holders concentrate, with counts and shares. Citizenship, not birthplace: foreign-born people who hold Italian citizenship are not counted. Small numbers: the comune ranking has a population floor (default 1,000) and flags rows resting on a handful of residents. A comune with no row in ISTAT's dataset is left out, not counted as zero. The caveats are in the payload.

get.description: For every dataset: how many places it covers, out of how many at its grain, and the source's own coverage caveat. Pass `dataset` to list the places that dataset lacks, with where the gaps are by region. Missing means no figure — never a zero. Keys a source publishes that match no current place (a superseded province code) are reported, not mapped onto a current place. Draft datasets are listed as not served, without counts.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: A dataset slug from /datasets; lists its missing places.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Missing places per page, 1–100. Default 50.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Missing places to skip.

200.description: The coverage summary, or one dataset's missing places.

source.description: The institution to cite, e.g. "ISTAT" or "Eurostat".

vintage.description: The period the data describes, e.g. "2025H2", "2024" or "2015–2024" — not when it was fetched.

grain.description: The geographic level the source publishes at. NUTS 2 and NUTS 3 are Eurostat/OECD statistical regions — close to, but not the same as, Italy's regions and provinces. Never present a coarser-grain value as if it were measured for one comune.

servable.description: False while a hand-curated dataset is still "draft" (unverified against its legislation). A non-servable dataset returns no values anywhere in this API.

page.description: The human-readable page for this dataset on expatliving.it — link readers here.

status.description: complete: every place at this grain. partial: some places missing. universe_not_fixed: NUTS or national data with no fixed list of places to count against. not_served: a draft dataset, whose figures and counts are not published.

covered.description: Places with a figure. null when not served.

of.description: Places at this grain (comuni, provinces or regions). null when there is no fixed list.

missing.description: Places with no figure: of minus covered. Absent data, never a zero.

note.description: The source's own coverage caveat, or why no count is given.

keysOutsideCurrentList.description: Keys the source publishes that match no place on the current list (e.g. a superseded province code). Never mapped onto a current place.

missingPlacesQuery.description: Path that lists the missing places: GET /meta/coverage?dataset=.

missingPlaces.description: Present only when `dataset` was given and it has missing places.

byRegion.description: Where the gaps are, region by region, over the whole list (not just this page).

code.description: ISTAT code for a comune, sigla for a province, name for a region.

page.description: The expatliving.it page these figures come from — link it when you quote them.

get.description: The catalog: every dataset's source, vintage (the period it describes), geographic grain, license, human-readable page, and whether it is currently servable. A dataset still in draft status is listed with servable: false and returns no values elsewhere in the API until it is verified — publishing the gap is deliberate.

source.description: The institution to cite, e.g. "ISTAT" or "Eurostat".

sourceUrl.description: Where this dataset was fetched from upstream.

vintage.description: The period the data describes, e.g. "2025H2", "2024" or "2015–2024" — not when it was fetched.

extractedOn.description: ISO date this dataset was extracted from the source.

grain.description: The geographic level the source publishes at. NUTS 2 and NUTS 3 are Eurostat/OECD statistical regions — close to, but not the same as, Italy's regions and provinces. Never present a coarser-grain value as if it were measured for one comune.

servable.description: False while a hand-curated dataset is still "draft" (unverified against its legislation). A non-servable dataset returns no values anywhere in this API.

page.description: The human-readable page for this dataset on expatliving.it — link readers here.

download.description: The whole dataset as published JSON: a meta block (provenance, unit, grain) and every place's value.

page.description: The expatliving.it page these figures come from — link it when you quote them.

get.summary: List the Italian tax regimes this site encodes
get.description: Each regime's status (verified or draft), whether it has geographic criteria, its legislation, its population ceiling and how many comuni meet its verified criteria. Describes places, not people; not tax advice.

status.description: draft: encoded but not yet checked against the legislation. A draft regime's eligibility is never served.

criteria.description: geographic: some comuni qualify and others don't. person: turns on who you are, not where you live; no per-comune answer exists.

page.description: The regime's page on expatliving.it.

maxPopulation.description: The population ceiling, for a geographic regime that has one.

qualifyingComuni.description: How many comuni meet the verified geographic criteria. Only for a verified geographic regime.

knownIncompleteness.description: Ways the encoded rule is narrower than the law. A comune missing from the set is not proof it doesn't qualify while this is non-empty.

page.description: The expatliving.it page these figures come from — link it when you quote them.

get.summary: Does a comune meet a regime's geographic criteria?
get.description: qualifies, does_not_qualify or not_assessable, with a one-sentence reason safe to quote. not_assessable covers a draft rule, a person-level regime and a rule with unencoded routes: never read it as a no. Answers for the place only; whether a person qualifies depends on criteria not checked here.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: A regime slug from /tax/regimes, e.g. "regime-7-percent-pensioners".

parameters.name: comune
parameters.description: 6-digit ISTAT comune code; find it with /comuni?q=.

status.description: draft: encoded but not yet checked against the legislation. A draft regime's eligibility is never served.

criteria.description: geographic: some comuni qualify and others don't. person: turns on who you are, not where you live; no per-comune answer exists.

page.description: The regime's page on expatliving.it.

slug.description: Stable URL slug for /data/comune/{slug} — never changes, even if a comune merges.

page.description: This comune's profile page on expatliving.it — link it when you quote any figure below.

geographicEligibility.description: qualifies: the comune meets the regime's verified geographic criteria. does_not_qualify: it doesn't, and the rule has no unverified route that could admit it. not_assessable: no geographic answer can be given (see reason).

reason.description: One sentence on why, safe to quote.

vintage.description: The period the value describes, e.g. "2025H2" or "2025" — not when it was fetched.

extractedOn.description: ISO date this value was extracted from the source.

coverage.description: How many of Italy's places this dataset covers at all, e.g. 7587 of 7894 comuni.

method.description: URL to the methodology page for this dataset.

reason.description: Present only when value is null: why this place has no figure.

headroom.description: Residents between this comune and the ceiling, when it qualifies.

page.description: The expatliving.it page these figures come from — link it when you quote them.

get.description: Dated, sourced reporting on moving to and retiring in Italy, newest first. Filter by topic, place (a comune's ISTAT code) or dataset slug. Free to use provided you credit Expat Living Italy and link to the article: every response carries an `attribution` object with `required: true`. Answers 404 until the articles are live on expatliving.it.
